items.title: Make evidence activation self-contained after explicit outcomes
items.context: playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply should activate qualifying candidates using deterministic recommendation evidence without requiring PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED as a separate manual gate. It must remain fail-closed without real exposure/outcome evidence, clean lineage, current digest, and non-harmful aggregate.
items.userSees: lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json activates eligible candidates after explicit helped outcomes.

happy.desc: Candidate with three explicit helped candidate-inspection outcomes activates via playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply without setting PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED.

edge.desc: Candidate with outcomes but stale candidate digest or duplicate lineage remains blocked.

adversarial.desc: DONE-settlement helped rows and exposureMode=none cannot activate.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke check M8 proves explicit helped candidate-inspection outcomes can activate through playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply without PLAYBOOK_PROMOTION_SWEEP_ENABLED.
Smoke covers stale candidate digest / stale recommendation fail-closed and duplicate lineage candidate/proposal rejection paths.
Smoke covers DONE-settlement rows, no-exposure rows, pre-outcome apply, malformed activation log, harmful/wrong-claim guards, and fail-closed no mutation.

items.title: Prove the full CLI consumption loop
items.context: A real dist CLI smoke should run seed observe/propose/approve, record explicit outcomes, apply evidence activation, and verify active runtime consumption while candidates remain inert until activation.
items.userSees: playbook seed becomes candidate, candidate receives outcome evidence, auto promotion activates it, and runtime consumption verification sees it active.

happy.desc: Dist CLI path reports activatedCount=1 and runtime activeChecks consumedByAll=true.

edge.desc: Second apply is idempotent and does not duplicate activation audit rows.

adversarial.desc: Activation apply fails closed before explicit outcomes and does not mutate playbooks.

items.title: Document Story 2 activation boundary
items.context: Docs must say V2 evidence activation is usable through playbook_auto_promotion_apply, but remains advisory/non-authoritative and separate from timers, trial traffic, historical backfill, and gate evidence.
items.userSees: Docs show the exact commands and explain that activation is evidence-based, not human subjective promotion and not DONE-success inference.

happy.desc: Docs include playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply and runtime consumption verification command sequence.

edge.desc: Docs distinguish automatic evidence activation from timer-driven promotion and historical backfill.

adversarial.desc: Docs explicitly forbid DONE success alone as helped or active guidance.

auditLog.reason: Implemented by commit edad40d1b and verified by build plus playbook seed promotion smoke.
